name: RRP Lead Paint Containment
intent: EPA RRP Rule containment for pre-1978 lead paint: containment setup, wet method prep, and teardown/waste disposal.
doctrine: EPA RRP Rule (40 CFR 745) containment for pre-1978 buildings with paint disturbance. Fixed-time tasks. Only included in scenarios gated by pre_1978=true. Containment setup includes poly sheeting, warning signs, HEPA vacuum staging. Wet method prevents airborne lead dust.
